_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Adiga ciyaartoy {player_id} ugu jirta ciyaarta LinesOfAction.
Qaybahayga waa '{side}', qaybahayga shayga waa '{other}'.
Qaabka guusha: `[b1b3]` (koordinaatada-asal ilaa koordinaatada-socod). Guusha sharci ah ayaa socda si toosan, ama si kor-ama-hoose, ama si karo, idadi sawirada oo ah qaybaha (midab kasta) ee safkaas. Waxaad ka gudbi kartaa qaybahaygaaga, laakiin qaybahayga shayga ma gudbo; halka aad ku soo degto shayga waxaad qabto.  Guusho marka qaybahayga oo dhan ay yihiin kuwa 8-deriska xiriira.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Qaabka waa in uu ahaadaa e2e4 (ka,ilaa isku xirka).
invalid_move.no_piece: Ma jiro {side} qayb ka mid ah {coord}.
invalid_move.identical: Asalka iyo halka loo socdo waa isku mid.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Dhaqdhaqaaqa waa in uu ahaadaa mid toos ah ama mid islaan ah.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Waa in uu u dhaqaaqaa masaafo u dhiganta xariiq.
invalid_move.destination_own: Meel ay u socdaan waxaa ku sugan heybad u gaar ah.

outcome.win: Dhamaan qaybaha waxay isku xiran yihiin.
outcome.draw_repetition: Booska waxaa lagu celiyaa sadex jeer.
